retrospective: 118577 and 128058 are excluded from training, selection and new scoring.

evidence_vocabulary.VALIDATED: Only a directly verified narrow fact, with source and uncertainty; not a global model certificate.
evidence_vocabulary.INTERNAL_OOF: Six exploratory match-excluded fits, not independent generalization.
evidence_vocabulary.PROXY_ONLY: Tracking geometry or algorithmic contact candidate, not physical touch.

targets.geometric: Future nearest eligible player at +1s and +2s; fixed current causal roster; ties <=0.2m and unsupported future labels censored.
targets.annotated_next_actor: Earliest uniquely timed supported BAS pass/high-pass/cross/shot/header actor in (t,t+1] and (t+1,t+2]; candidate recall and unsupported identities reported. Annotation semantics, not video-certified touch.
targets.action: Inherited disjoint 0-1,1-2,2-3s BAS labels; additional 3-5s only if reconstruction supports equivalent censoring.

model: Fixed HGB 100 iterations, max depth5, leaves15, min leaf50, L2=1, seed42. No test tuning. Reuse verified current/history/interpretable predictions where exact targets match.
counterfactual: Remove last 0.48s (12 frames) of joint player-ball observations; all dynamic/static features reconstructed at that past frame, current roster fixed. No cross-time actor-ball mismatch.
tactical: Causal source teams/positions at query; no inferred possession team, no guessed attack direction; family ablation opponent and same-team pressure.

external.purpose: Official synchronized anonymous 105x68m,25Hz tracking/event pilot, about 66MB; nonredistributed, acknowledge Metrica Sports.
external.evaluation: Domain-shift pilot, not SoccerTrack sealed evaluation. Freeze label rules, features and metrics before any model result. Transfer compact 2s-relative-physics models trained on six SoccerTrack fits; no external fine-tuning. Also diagnostic geometric/event association, never pretend event taxonomies identical.

review: The 120-case queue remains unadjudicated. Audit existing 60-case historical human pass reviews and exact identity/clip provenance separately. No new human labels; no forced negatives.
adaptive: At least three distinct hypotheses locked in adaptive_decisions.json before fitting each, after stages1-8 actual findings.
protection: All original data, checkpoints, historical outputs, splits read-only. All new code/data caches/models private evidence stay in this fresh run. No commit/push.
resources: CPU8 threads; CUDA only for justified model hypothesis; no runtime filler.
